summary: Trio Petroleum Canada, Corp., a wholly owned subsidiary of NYSE American-listed Trio Petroleum Corp, entered a September 25, 2026 Purchase and Sale Agreement with Marlin Resources Ltd. to acquire interests in 24 oil wells (four producing, 20 shut-in heavy-oil assets) for CAD 800,000 cash, plus conveyance of certain Trio Canada assets and interests and a produced-water disposal agreement with Marlin as operator. Closing is subject to standard conditions including no-interest letters and conveyances. Trio filed an 8-K and press release. Watch for closing and production restart economics; CAD-denominated, no per-share terms apply.
